title: Confidence lifecycle + surfacing priority
description:
## Parent

sutra/150 — Code-anchored lessons: sutra_remember / contextual surfacing

## What to build

The quality ratchet: citation-based verification, anti-verification, and surfacing priority rules.

**Citation as verification:** `sutra_remember(cite: lesson_id)` records a citation with task ID and timestamp. Each citation increases confidence. When confidence crosses a threshold (TBD, likely 2-3 citations), `verified` flips to true. Citations are durable and auditable in the `citations` table.

**Anti-verification:** A new mode on `sutra_remember` (or a dedicated call) to flag a lesson as wrong/outdated. Drops confidence. Does not delete — the lesson may be corrected rather than removed.

**Surfacing priority rules in `query_for_context()`:**
- Verified lessons: always shown when anchors match
- Unverified lessons: shown only when no verified lessons cover the same context
- Unverified lessons flagged as `[unverified]` in the response
- "Same context" means the same anchor matched — not globally, but per-anchor overlap

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `sutra_remember(cite: lesson_id)` records a citation and increases confidence
- [ ] Confidence crossing threshold flips verified to true
- [ ] Anti-verification mode drops confidence
- [ ] Verified lessons always surface when anchors match
- [ ] Unverified lessons only surface when no verified lessons match the same context
- [ ] Unverified lessons carry `[unverified]` flag in response
- [ ] Tests: citation increases confidence, threshold verification, anti-verification, surfacing priority with mixed verified/unverified lessons

## Blocked by

- sutra/157 — 5x-review-2

messages.author: codex
messages.text:
Codex adversarial review: needs-attention. Three findings:

1. [high] Duplicate cite calls inflate confidence — no idempotency on (lesson_id, task_id). Two identical calls → verified=true.
2. [high] Verified lessons can be truncated by CONTEXT_SURFACING_CAP if unverified lessons fill the cap first.
3. [medium] Priority filter compares ALL stored anchors, not just matched anchors — broader suppression than spec intends.

messages.author: agent
messages.text:
All three codex findings addressed in da4369b:
1. Idempotent cite via UNIQUE index + INSERT OR IGNORE + changes() check
2. Verified-first sort before CONTEXT_SURFACING_CAP truncation
3. Matched-anchor tracking during collection; priority filter compares only anchors that matched this context

3 new regression tests: duplicate_cite_is_idempotent, multi_anchor_no_false_suppression, cap_prioritizes_verified_over_unverified. Full suite 40/40 green."
